answers.interpretation: v2 over-tightened direct-answer selection and removed both signed Mitsui answer atoms while still retaining two known false answers

challenges.interpretation: the added contrast/self-correction prose shifted decisions in both directions and reduced signed calibration stability

supports_and_conditions.interpretation: the explicit-link rules were stable in this execution and are not the active regression source

capacity_observation.interpretation: one independent terminal per pair forces the model to make 299 repeated answer judgments; prompt-only wording did not provide stable question-level assignment

design_constraints: group each question with only its controller-owned adjacent answer atoms
return selected answer-atom indexes once per question instead of one present/absent terminal per pair
controller expands selected indexes back to immutable pair/relation identities
keep supports and conditions on the existing stable path
freeze P11 signed cases as regression fixtures and do zero-call fake/replay before any new live budget
